title: CELEBRITY: a watch a trusted outlet reported a celebrity wearing (recent)
why: Owner wants celebrity posts. One readable trusted outlet naming the watch is enough, credited by name. Celebrity photo does not need to show the watch: their photo + the official watch photo (A-spotted). Lead found earlier today: WatchGuys 2026 VMAs roundup (readable) names David Corenswet wearing a Rolex GMT-Master II Pepsi ref. 126710BLRO; free Wikimedia photo of him exists. If no usable photo, pick another celebrity. Not Tyson Fury.
